message: Turn 34 fixed at f6afaa01cfdb785329937b8862b5b69dc4bdeb15, Dispatcher 2.2.9. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_bootstrap.py exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK and inferTurnRole: OK, exit 0. Semantics: a visible bootstrap marker, CONTROL READY, or the pending wake plus a different valid /c/ page.url is not stale. That observed URL is written in the same replace that preserves recovery_used, recovery_reason, recovered_from, and bootstrap_sent_at. ready_idle applies only when the bootstrap user message is visible, generation is not active, the composer is visible and enabled, and 20 seconds have elapsed since bootstrap_sent_at. It does not fire while a stop button is visible. recovery_used never starts another chat, and a visible bootstrap is not resent. A ready channel sends the pending wake once under the existing de-duplication. CONTROL_RETRY_SECONDS, DOM-role tests, and text-free diagnostics are unchanged. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
